name: Escape The World Obby 🌎 [Mega Easy]
desc:
Parkour trough different biomes from everywhere in the world, race with your friens and buy cute pets 🌎 🐶

🏆 If you parkour past all 250 obstacles, there is a fun surprise.

💾 progress in this obby will save 💾

We make new updates to the obby very often, so join our group and come back soon 📬.
Thank you for playing this parkour obby 🎇!

Big thanks to JOKESOY for the game icon.

Auto TP to next stage only (not repeating old ones)

Removed ESP distance, keeps only ESP player name

Adjust Speed Walk

Adjustable jump

Infinite jump 

Full ReGui layout as before
